description: This PHP source file defines the ModuleListProvider class, which provides methods to retrieve and process a list of modules with access control and labels, used within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ModuleListProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve and process module lists with access control and labels within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of modules accessible to the current user, filters invisible modules, marks access permissions, and adds labels.

methods.name: addModuleLabels
methods.description: Adds human-readable labels to modules based on the global app_list_strings.

methods.name: removeInvisibleModules
methods.description: Removes modules from the list that are marked as invisible.

methods.name: markACLAccess
methods.description: Marks modules with access permissions based on the current user's ACL actions.

methods.name: buildAccessArray
methods.description: Builds an array of actions the user has access to for a specific module.

methods.name: hasACL
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin privileges or specific ACL access level for a module.
